title: The 3 Best Robot Lawn Mowers for Pet Owners in 2026
h1: The 3 Best Robot Lawn Mowers for Pet Owners in 2026
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for robot lawn mowers for pet owners in 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at robot lawn mowers for pet owners in 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Husqvarna Automower 115H
products.blurb: Key specs: 0.4-acre (17,000 sq ft) coverage, PIN-protected lift sensor with immediate blade shutoff, Quiet operation rated well below typical gas mower noise.
strengths: Immediate blade stop on lift or tilt is a genuine, well-safety mechanism
Quiet operation is noticeably less startling to nervous pets than louder competitors
App scheduling makes it easy to run mowing sessions when pets are indoors
Boundary wire can fence off a dog run or garden bed as a permanent no-go zone
limitations: Does not detect or avoid pet waste on its own
Some dogs still need a supervised adjustment period regardless of noise level
0.4-acre ceiling limits it to smaller yards
features: PIN-protected lift sensor with immediate blade shutoff
Quiet operation rated well below typical gas mower noise
Scheduling app to avoid peak pet outdoor time
Boundary wire keeps the mower out of marked no-go zones

products.name: Worx Landroid M (WR147)
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/4-acre (10,890 sq ft) coverage, AIA narrow-passage navigation, Floating blade disc that raises on obstruction.
strengths: No-go zone mapping fences off a doghouse, water bowl area, or dig zone easily
AIA navigation is useful for yards where a pet area splits the lawn into sections
Floating blade disc raises automatically if it contacts an obstruction
Lower price than the Automower 115H for similarly equipped safety features
limitations: Smaller coverage ceiling than the Automower 115H
Still requires boundary wire for the outer perimeter
No dedicated pet-detection technology beyond generic collision sensors
features: Floating blade disc that raises on obstruction
